name: Phu Nhai basilica
nameVi: Vương cung thánh đường Phú Nhai
summary: Look at the gray church the 2018 city page calls one of the widest in the country, at xã Xuân Phương, more than 1 km from thị trấn Xuân Trường. A height, a fee, and a mass hour were not printed on that page. Check on arrival. It is not Nhà thờ Lớn in the center, and it is not Phát Diệm.
getThere: Toward Xuân Trường, the same direction as quốc lộ 21. Minutes were not printed.
heroCaption: The facade and the front court at Phú Nhai

notice.title: No mass hour was printed
notice.body: The 2018 city page names the church and does not print a mass hour, a height, or a fee. Check on arrival.

body: The 2018 city page places Vương cung thánh đường Phú Nhai at xã Xuân Phương, huyện Xuân Trường, more than 1 km from thị trấn Xuân Trường, and calls it one of the widest churches in the country. You look at the facade from the front court. A height and a fee were not printed there. A mass hour was not on that page. Check on arrival.

Do not merge it with Nhà thờ Lớn, the center parish at số 16 phố Hai Bà Trưng, or with Tòa giám mục Bùi Chu at xã Xuân Ngọc. The same page dates Bùi Chu from 1885 and prints 78 m long, 22 m wide, and 15 m high. A mass hour for Bùi Chu was not printed. Phát Diệm’s stone church is in Kim Sơn, on the Ninh Bình side.

figures.caption: The long side of the church, with the arched windows
figures.alt: The side of Phu Nhai basilica, gray stone and tall arched windows, with potted trees

gettingThere: The city page places the church more than 1 km from thị trấn Xuân Trường. Quốc lộ 21 is the road the planning decision names from the city through Cổ Lễ and Xuân Trường. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Nam Dinh
legs.body: Toward Xuân Trường, more than 1 km from the town once you are there. The minutes from the center were not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed on the city page.
admissionNote: A fee was not printed on the 2018 city page. Check on arrival. No child rule was printed.
